meta.title: Ekklesias
meta.description: Register your church members with a tap, respecting their privacy.

home.tagline: Register your church members with a tap, respecting their privacy.

tap.title: One tap or a QR code
tap.body: Hold the phone to the card and the form opens. Nothing to install.

consent.title: Clear consents
consent.body: Each permission is its own checkbox, recorded with date, version and source.

tenants.title: One platform, many churches
tenants.body: Each church has its own data, branding and team, fully separated.

church.intro: Registering helps us stay in touch. You decide what you share and how we contact you.

fields.phoneHint: Include the country code if it is not Spain, for example +49…
fields.birthHint: We only use it to know whether we need a guardian’s permission.
fields.invitedByHint: Write their name, it helps us say hello.

guardian.notice: As you are under 14, we need the consent of your parent or guardian.
guardian.confirm: I am their parent or legal guardian and I give consent on their behalf.

permissions.intro: Tick only what you want. No box is ticked in advance and you can change your mind at any time.

errors.phone: Enter a valid mobile number, with the country code if it is not Spain.
errors.birthDate: Enter a valid date of birth.
errors.consent: We need you to accept this in order to register you.
errors.guardian: Fill in your parent or guardian’s details and tick their consent.
errors.server: We could not complete the registration. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.rateLimit: Too many forms were sent from this connection. Please wait a while and try again.

thanks.title: Thank you for registering!
thanks.inviteBody: Share it with anyone you want to invite. When someone registers with it, we will know you invited them.

legal.draft: Draft in progress. This text is not the final version yet and is pending legal review.

preferences.title: Hello, {name}
preferences.intro: Here you can change your permissions at {church} whenever you like. Only the changes you make are saved.
preferences.error: We could not save your changes. Please try again.
preferences.invalidBody: This link has expired or is not correct. Ask your church for a new one.
preferences.withdrawNote: To withdraw your permission to keep your data as a member, or to ask us to delete your data, use
preferences.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from messages
unsubscribe.body: We will stop sending you messages by email, WhatsApp and SMS. You will remain registered as a member.
unsubscribe.doneBody: You will not receive any more messages. You can turn them back on whenever you like from your preferences link.
unsubscribe.invalidBody: This link has expired or is not correct. Ask your church for a new one.
unsubscribe.tooManyBody: Wait a few minutes and open the link again.

rights.title: Your rights over your data
rights.intro: You can ask {church} for access, rectification, erasure, portability or objection regarding your data. We will answer within one month.
rights.emailHint: We only use it to answer your request.
rights.type: What do you want to ask for?

types.access: Access: know what data you hold about me
types.portability: Portability: receive my data in a file

errors.type: Choose what you want to ask for.
errors.server: We could not send your request. Please try again.
errors.rate: Too many requests were sent. Please wait a while and try again.

rights.sentBody: If that email matches a registration, the church will reply within one month.
